name: get_event
description: Fetch a single event by UID from a named calendar. Returns data (raw iCalendar text) plus uid, summary, start, end, timezone, description, location and status. start/end are ISO 8601 with an offset for zoned, UTC or legacy fixed-offset values, a bare local time for floating values, or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day events. timezone is the IANA name, 'UTC', the legacy TZID as stored (e.g. 'UTC+03:00'), 'floating', null for all-day events, or the raw TZID when unknown.

calendar_name.description: Name of the calendar containing the event.

uid.description: UID of the event to retrieve.
